emails.subject: Start here: your Roadmap to your first grant
emails.preview_text: Welcome. Open your Roadmap and do three small things today.

emails.subject: Step 1: let me show you around the community
emails.preview_text: A live tour every day at 11 AM New York time. Or watch it whenever you like.

emails.subject: Step 2: build your personal grant call list
emails.preview_text: Programs that fit you, not ten thousand search results. Three easy ways to make yours.

emails.subject: Step 3: applying for grants, with help from us
emails.preview_text: Nobody fills in these forms alone here. We go through real applications together.

emails.subject: Step 4: get your questions answered by a coach
emails.preview_text: Everybody gets stuck. This is the room where you get unstuck.

emails.subject: Step 5: come and ask me anything, live
emails.preview_text: I answer member questions live. About money, programs, and your own situation.

emails.subject: If you want your own business, this one is for you
emails.preview_text: Grant money exists for starting a business, a nonprofit, or a new career.

emails.subject: The habit that finds members their grants
emails.preview_text: Guides, answers, and real stories from members who got their yes.
